name: Meat smoked over the fire
summary: VnExpress calls thịt gác bếp a Thai specialty of Quan Hóa and Bá Thước: buffalo or pork belly, smoked slowly, dry outside and still soft and sweet inside, dark pink. A 26 Sep 2026 market article also names thịt treo gác bếp among highland-market goods, including Phố Đoàn and a market at Na Mèo, without a cut or a smoke time. Both stand.
